summary: Reversed Bernoulli parameter in the general-rho alternative sampling representation on publisher p911; exact correction proved. Main explicit formulas independently agree.
limitations: Long geometric/coupling dependencies not all re-proved

problems.title: Reversed Bernoulli parameter in alternative representation

source_location.heading: An alternative representation of the weights on geodesics

problems.claim: Positive-integer Geometric(rho) X obeys X-1 d= B X with independent Bernoulli(rho) B; then L(0,1)=(E3+B E4)/rho under Psi^(2).
problems.check_method: Exact analytic distribution comparison and repair proof
problems.decisive_evidence: rho=1/3: P(X-1=0)=1/3 vs P(BX=0)=2/3. At h=1 the printed waiting-time survival is 10 exp(-1/3)/9 while Lemma4.2 gives 11 exp(-1/3)/9. The conditional-minimum survival is 50/(27e) vs55/(27e).
problems.result: The printed representation fails for rho !=1/2.
counterevidence: Lemma4.2-based derivations of Props1.5/1.6 reproduce the stated formulas
Visual page check confirms parameter is not an extraction artifact
Source convention rules out swapped Bernoulli semantics
problems.impact: Local alternate distributional representation; no demonstrated damage to preceding principal formulas or main convergence theorems.

correction.statement: Replace three general-rho Bernoulli(rho) parameters by Bernoulli(1-rho).
correction.verification: P(BX'=0)=rho and P(BX'=k)=rho(1-rho)^k for k>=1; survival (1+rho(1-rho)h)e^(-rho h) matches Lemma4.2.

acceptance_check.source_claim_and_assumptions: Publisher PDF pp13,34-36 and author-v2 p29 checked; positive-support Geometric(p), standard Bernoulli and independence are explicit. Source PDF p35 image actually viewed by current primary.
acceptance_check.independent_argument: At p=1/3 the zero masses are 1/3 and 2/3. For independent Exp(1) E3,E4 and Bernoulli(b) B the survival of (E3+B E4)/p equals (1+b p h)exp(-p h). b=p gives 10/9 versus required11/9 at h=1; multiplying the independent Gamma2 waiting-time survival gives50/(27e) versus55/(27e). With b=1-p, P(BX'=k)=p(1-p)^k for k>=1 and zero mass p, proving the correction for every0<p<1.
acceptance_check.counterevidence_and_core_dependency: At p=1/2 parameters coincide. Recomputed the conditional-survival mixture and corner integral; Lemma4.2 and preceding principal formulas agree. The faulty extra representation is not a dependency of the main convergence proof, supporting Minor.
acceptance_check.repair_scope: Three general-p Bernoulli parameters change to1-p; only this representation and its exact distributional repair are confirmed. No whole-paper guarantee.

clarifications.detail: Radius factor-two notation locally corrected by matching 2r+1 vertices with 2km+1; no separate substantive failure claimed.
Sufficient parity independence m>2s, endpoint error <=2s/m and signed-increment count supplied in report; no extra Problem established.
